content.text: don't wait for PCR: start IV acyclovir promptly until HSV & VZV encephalitis excluded; cont USU 14 days or until these viruses excluded; can cause LFT abnormalities · marrow suppression & transient renal failure; giving it IV slowly over 1 h w adequate hydration helps prevent nephrotoxicity
Acyclovir (acyclovir sodium) dose, HSV encephalitis (adults and adolescents):
Adults & adolescents ≥12 y: 10 mg/kg IV infused @ a constant rate over 1 h, every 8 h for 10 days. When dosage adj required, base them on est CrCl
Acyclovir (acyclovir sodium) administration and renal safety:

IV infusion only — ⍉ topical · IM · PO · SC or ocular. Infuse over ≥1 h to reduce risk of renal tubular damage. Renal failure, in some cases fatal, observed w acyclovir therapy. TTP/HUS, which has resulted in death, occurred in immunocompromised pts receiving acyclovir. Adequate hydration must accompany IV infusion. Other nephrotoxic drugs · pre-existing renal dz & dehydration make further renal impairment more likely
~1% of pts on IV acyclovir show encephalopathic chgs (lethargy · obtundation · tremors · confusion · hallucinations · agitation · sz · coma)
Acyclovir (acyclovir sodium) max dose, CI, interactions, OD:

Max dose ≤20 mg/kg every 8 h for any pt. CI: hypersensitivity to acyclovir or valacyclovir. Probenecid ↑ acyclovir ½ life & AUC - urinary excretion & renal clearance correspondingly ↓. OD (ingestions up to 20 g reported): agitation · coma · sz · lethargy. Acute renal failure w anuria may benefit from hemodialysis until renal funct restored
